npcs.name: Dagny Dagnarsdottir
npcs.idle: My father mapped half of Muspelheim. I mean to map the other half.

npcs.name: Sven Ashbeard
npcs.idle: Fire giants took my shield-mates. All of them but one.

npcs.name: Huscarl Hallkel
npcs.idle: Muspelheim. The King sends us here when he's cross with us. Lately he sends us here because of the smoke.

npcs.name: Forge-Master Thrain
npcs.idle: Every fire in Muspelheim is a dverge's business. Lately someone's selling ours.

quests.title: The Mapmaker's Chest
quests.offer:
My father Dagnar went into Muspelheim three years ago to map it. He never came out. Last month a huscarl told me he'd seen Dagnar's chest by a giants' bridge in the west - battered, lying open.

I want to know what happened. Will you [find the chest]? I'll go mad sitting here another month.
quests.summary: Dagny's father went into Muspelheim to map it and never returned. His battered chest has been seen in the west.

steps.goal: Go to the giants' bridge in the west
steps.text: Charred skeletons patrol the bridge, back and forth, as if guarding something long gone.

Dagnar's chest, burned and scratched, the maps gone. His journal is wedged in the lid. The last entry: 'Going south to the fire-dwarves' mines to trade. The forgemaster wants my maps. I will not give them.'

steps.goal: Go south to the fire-dwarves' mines
steps.text: Furnaces roar. Fire-dwarves - dverge - work the forges and watch you sidelong.

steps.goal: Speak with Hrafnhild of the dverge
steps.say: The cold-man with the maps? He's alive. Forgemaster Ulvrik keeps him in the furnace-hall, half-blind from the glow, drawing maps for him. Ulvrik means to sell them to the fire giants. The rest of us don't like it. We'll look away while you [deal with him].

steps.text: The forgemaster's hammer falls from his hand. In the back of the hall, an old man looks up from a desk of maps.

stages.name: Forgemaster Ulvrik
stages.announce: A dverge in a leather apron glowing with heat shoulders out of the furnace-hall. 'The cold-man's mine. His maps are mine.'

steps.say:
Dagny? Dagny sent you? My Dagny? She was fourteen when I left.

I can't see well any more. But I finished them. Every road in Muspelheim, every pass to the giants' halls. The [maps].

steps.goal: Decide what becomes of the maps
steps.say:
These would let the jarls march an army into Muspelheim - right to the fire giants' doors. War, on their ground for once. Glory, and a great deal of death.

Or fire takes what it's given. [Burn them], and nobody follows my roads. Or [give them to the jarls]. I spent three years and my eyes on them. I can't choose.

options.say: Then take them. Tell the jarls Dagnar the Mapmaker sends his compliments. And his bill.
...In the furnace, then. Fire takes what it's given. ...There. Three years. It burns very prettily.

steps.say:
He's alive. He's ALIVE. He's asleep in my tent and he's grey and blind and ALIVE.

The jarls' men are already copying the maps. There'll be war in the fire-lands by summer. He says he doesn't mind. I don't believe him.

He burned them. Three years. He says it was the best thing he ever drew.

He wants to teach me mapmaking. With his hands on mine, since he can't see. We'll start with Muspelheim, he says. Just the parts no one should follow.

jarls.text: Take something. You gave me my father.

burned.text: Take something. You gave me my father.

quests.title: The Lay of Ragnvald
quests.offer:
This is GROUP work, friend. Bring axes.

The fire giants took my patrol. Eight huscarls. I was the only one who got out. The skald who marched with us, Ragnvald, was taken alive - they keep skalds, to sing for their thanes.

He's the only one who knows how my shield-mates died. I need him alive. I need the [song]. Will you [get him back]?

topics.song: What he saw. How they died. I was knocked down in the first rush and woke up alone.

quests.summary: GROUP. Fire giants captured a huscarl patrol's skald. Sven Ashbeard, the only survivor, needs him alive.

steps.goal: Go to the fire giants' lookout posts in the east
steps.text: Giants on the ridges, watching the plain. They haven't seen you. Yet.
Ragnvald's harp. Scratched into the frame in his hand: 'Taken south to the thane's camp. Still singing.' Under it, much smaller: 'Tell Sven I'm sorry.'

steps.goal: Cut through the flaming raukomaz on the road south
Free Ragnvald from the fire giants' camp
steps.text: The giants fall back to their fires. Ragnvald sits in the ash and doesn't look at you.

stages.name: Keep Ragnvald alive
stages.announce: Ragnvald is chained to a stake, singing hoarsely to a ring of giants. They turn as you come in.
stages.thanks: Sven's alive? Sven? Gods. Then he'll want to know.

stages.name: Thane Surtling
stages.announce: A fire giant in iron and flame. 'The skald sings for ME. Find your own.'

steps.say:
I've written the lay, you know. 'The Last Stand of Ashbeard's Eight.' Eight huscarls holding the pass against the giants, to the last man. It's the best thing I've ever made.

It isn't true. I led them into the ambush. To save myself - I bargained. I bargained with the [giants].

Ragnvald. Alive. And he's told you something - I can see it on your face.

He sold us. Didn't he. ...Then you choose, because I can't. [The truth], and he's outlawed and my men died for nothing. Or [let the song stand], and the lay goes round every hall in Midgard, and my shield-mates are heroes forever. And he walks free.

options.say: The truth. Aye. My men deserve the truth, even if the truth is a coward. ...Get out of my sight, skald. Run. The jarls will hear it before nightfall.
Heroes forever. Let him sing it, then. Let him sing it every night, and know. That's punishment enough. It'll have to be.

truth.text: Take something from the giants' hoard. You earned it more than I did.

song.text: Take something from the giants' hoard.

quests.title: The Noxious Hounds
quests.offer:
The noxious hounds come up to the camp every night - sulphur on their breath, and they don't mind fire. Not at all.

Will you [drive them off]?
quests.summary: Noxious hounds come up to Brika's camp every night in Muspelheim.

steps.goal: Drive off the noxious hounds about 330 m south of Huscarl Hallkel

steps.say: Quieter. Thank you. Now you've seen the place, you'll want to know why we're here.

quests.title: Smoke Over the Vale
quests.offer:
The smoke over Muspelheim has turned black, and it drifts down over the Vale. The vapor wraiths at the vents east of here are stirring the fires - and the firecats run before them.

Will you [clear the vents]?
quests.summary: Vapor wraiths stir Muspelheim's fires at the vents; black smoke drifts down over the Vale.

steps.goal: Clear the vapor wraiths at the vents about 320 m south of Huscarl Hallkel

steps.say:
The vents settle. But the black smoke isn't from them - it's from the hills to the west. Something's burning there that never burned before.

Forge-Master Thrain at the dverge hold in the south will know. Dverge know every fire.

quests.title: The Ash Road
quests.offer:
The ash road from our hold runs north through the ashmongers' country. They never troubled the caravans before. Now they attack everything.

Will you [clear the road]?
quests.summary: Ashmongers attack every caravan on Muspelheim's ash road.

steps.goal: Clear the ashmongers from the ash road about 270 m north of Forge-Master Thrain

steps.say: Good. The ash-folk are restless because the fires moved. Fires don't move. Someone moved them.

quests.title: The Soot-Folk
quests.offer:
The soot harvesters and flame throwers in the western ash fields used to trade soot to us for iron. Now they throw fire at our carts.

Will you [quiet the ash fields]?
quests.summary: The soot harvesters and flame throwers of Muspelheim's ash fields throw fire at the dverge carts.

steps.goal: Quiet the soot harvesters about 450 m north-west of Forge-Master Thrain

steps.say: Quiet. One of them had a pouch of fire-salt on it - our fire-salt, from our forge. Somebody's selling it.

quests.title: The Sulphur Pits
quests.offer:
We take sulphur from the pits in the west. The fire ants have dug into them, and they bite through iron boots.

Will you [clear the pits]?
quests.summary: Fire ants have dug into the dverge sulphur pits in Muspelheim's west.

steps.goal: Clear the fire ant workers about 690 m north of Forge-Master Thrain

steps.say: The pits are ours again. Good. We'll need the sulphur - there's trouble coming.

quests.title: The Fire-Sellers
quests.offer:
Some of our own - dverge who left the forge - camp south of the hold and call themselves the fire-sellers. They sell our fire-salt. To whom, I want to know.

Will you [break their camp]?
quests.summary: Renegade dverge, the fire-sellers, camp south of Khizil's hold and sell the forge's fire-salt.

steps.goal: Break the dverge sparkers about 180 m south of Forge-Master Thrain

steps.text: Gold, a great deal of it, and a tally: 'Fire-salt, forty sacks, to the brood-priests in the wyrm hills. To keep the Mother's eggs warm.'

steps.say:
'The Mother's eggs.' Gjalpinulva. The dragon under Malmohus. They're selling our fire to keep a dragon's brood warm.

I need the ones who sold it.

quests.title: The Ringleaders
quests.offer:
The igniters and cracklers - they're the ringleaders. Bring friends; they throw fire like rain.

Will you [bring them to account]?
quests.summary: Renegade dverge igniters and cracklers lead the fire-sellers south of Khizil's hold.

steps.goal: Bring down the dverge igniters about 220 m south of Forge-Master Thrain

steps.say: Done. The forge won't sell another grain. But they've sold forty sacks already - the hatchery in the wyrm hills is warm enough. Hallkel's huscarls need to see it.

quests.title: The Burnt Sentries
quests.offer:
The middle of Muspelheim was a battlefield once - the dead still stand their watch there, burnt black. They've begun marching.

Will you [put them down]?
quests.summary: The burnt dead of Muspelheim's old battlefield have begun marching.

steps.goal: Put down the burnt skeletal sentries about 710 m north-west of Ragnvald the Skald

steps.say: Marching. The dead of an old war don't march without a reason.

quests.title: The Old War
quests.offer:
I'm a skald. I want the song of the old war - who these dead were, and who burned them. The charred warriors hold the middle of the field.

Will you [find out]?
quests.summary: Charred warriors hold the middle of Muspelheim's old battlefield; nobody remembers the war.

steps.goal: Fight through the charred skeletal warriors about 680 m north-west of Ragnvald the Skald

steps.text: The shields all bear the same mark: a dragon, struck through with a spear. A rune-stone in the cairn: 'Here the hosts of Midgard held the Wyrm-Mother's brood. Here they burned. Here she slept.'

steps.say:
The Wyrm-Mother. Gjalpinulva. They fought her brood here, long ago, and she went to sleep under Malmohus after. The dead march because the brood is back.

That's the song. I'd rather it ended differently this time.

quests.title: The Wyrm Hills
quests.offer:
The young fire wyrms in the northern hills have never been so many. They're being bred. We need to get close to the hatchery - and the wyrms are in the way.

Will you [thin them out]?
quests.summary: Young fire wyrms swarm Muspelheim's northern hills, bred at a hatchery.

steps.goal: Thin out the young fire wyrms about 740 m west of Huscarl Hallkel

steps.say: Thinner. And they're all young - a single brood. Somebody's keeping a dragon's nursery up there.

quests.title: The Cinder Drakes
quests.offer:
The cinder drakes guard the hatchery's eastern flank - grown wyrms, the brood's elders. Bring friends.

Will you [break the nest]?
quests.summary: Cinder drakes guard the eastern flank of the dragon's hatchery in Muspelheim's wyrm hills.

steps.goal: Break the cinder drakes' nest about 380 m south-west of Huscarl Hallkel

steps.say: The flank's open. Now the hatchery itself.

quests.title: The Hatchery
quests.offer:
The hatchery. The brood-priests keep it, with their brood-keepers. Kill the keepers, get into the warming-pits, and see what they're hatching.

Bring friends. Will you [raid the hatchery]?
quests.summary: Gjalpinulva's drakulv keep a hatchery in Muspelheim's wyrm hills, warming the dragon's brood.

steps.goal: Kill the drakulv brood-keepers about 540 m west of Huscarl Hallkel

clue.name: eggs as big as shields, in the lava

steps.text: A dozen eggs in the lava, and the brood-priests' rite on a slab: 'When the Hierophant speaks the Mother's whole name in Malmohus, the brood wakes with her. Keep them warm till then.'

steps.say:
The whole name. Galplen's volva has the other half - so the priests in Myrkwood said. If the Hierophant gets it, the Mother wakes, and this brood with her.

The Hatch-Mother still keeps the pits. And the Brood-Sire ranges the hills - you'll see it when it comes. Midgard will need everyone, when it comes.
